title: Fix search document tsvector insert
description: Search reindex fails on Postgres because SQLAlchemy maps text_vector as Text and includes it in INSERT into a tsvector column. Remove ORM writes for the generated tsvector column and keep it managed by raw Postgres SQL.
close_reason: Fixed SearchDocument.text_vector ORM type/default so reindex inserts omit the generated tsvector column, plus regression coverage.

title: Fix API key timestamp defaults
description: Creating an API key can fail in Postgres because api_keys.created_at and updated_at are NOT NULL but the applied migration created them without server defaults. Align the migration/schema and service insert path so API key creation always populates timestamps.
close_reason: Added an api_keys timestamp-default migration and populated timestamps in API key creation.

title: Gate mutating API routes with write-scope dependencies
description: Several authenticated mutating routes use only the router-level identity check, so viewer users or read-only API keys can reach write/job-triggering paths. Add FastAPI dependencies that enforce write scope and the appropriate role, and cover the missed routes with RBAC tests.
close_reason: Implemented write-scope dependencies on missed mutating routes and added RBAC regression coverage.

close_reason: Successfully resolved all 48 backend-wide mypy type-checking errors across the codebase. Strict mypy analysis now passes with 100% success.

title: Foundation: design tokens, primitives & status lifecycle alignment
description:
## Foundation: design tokens, shared primitives & status lifecycle alignment

Shared groundwork the other 8 surface tasks build on. Most of this already exists in the repo
(`index.css`, `components/primitives/`, `components/ui/`) — this task is to **audit and align**
to the mockup, not rebuild.

### Mockup reference
- `design/tripl/project/styles.css` (tokens, form controls, toggle, nav item)
- `design/tripl/project/primitives.jsx` (`Icon`, `Sparkline`, `Dot`, `Chip`, `Btn`)
- `design/tripl/project/data.jsx` lines 40–48 (`STATUS_LABELS`, `STATUS_TONE`)

### Real files
- `frontend/src/index.css`
- `frontend/src/components/primitives/{chip,dot,sparkline,mini-stat,kbd,sensitivity-chip}.tsx`
- `frontend/src/components/ui/{button,badge,select,switch,input,textarea}.tsx`

### Details to verify / align
- **Tokens**: radius 8/6/12; surfaces (`--bg`,`--bg-elevated`,`--bg-sunken`,`--surface`,
  `--surface-hover`,`--surface-active`); fg `--fg/--fg-muted/--fg-subtle/--fg-faint`;
  borders `--border/-strong/-subtle`; semantic `success/warning/danger/info` + `-soft`;
  shadows sm/md/lg. Density classes set `--row-h` to 28/36/44; `--header-h` 44.
- **Decision**: mockup defaults density to **compact**; repo default is **cozy**. Decide
  whether to switch the default (mockup chose compact for 2k+ row scale). Flag, don't assume.
- **Chip**: sizes xs/sm/md (h 18/20/24, fs 10.5/11/12); tones neutral/accent/success/warning/
  danger/info; variants soft/outline; optional leading icon. Confirm parity.
- **Btn**: variants primary/secondary/ghost/outline/danger; sizes xs/sm/md (h 22/28/32);
  icon-only square at sm (28×28); `active` state for toggles.
- **Sparkline**: variants line / line-only (stroke) / bar; gradient area fill; `anomalyIdx`
  marker (danger dot/bar); width/height props.
- **Dot**: tones + `pulse` animation (1.8s); sizes.
- **Status lifecycle** (single source of truth): `draft→in_review→ready_for_dev→implemented→
  live→deprecated→archived` with tones draft=neutral, in_review=warning, ready_for_dev=info,
  implemented=success, live=success, deprecated=warning, archived=neutral. Reconcile with the
  real status enum in `types/`; expose shared `STATUS_LABELS`/`STATUS_TONE` helpers.
- **Sensitivity**: none/pii/phi/financial/secret with the mockup `SENS_STYLE` colors; reuse
  `sensitivity-chip.tsx` and `types/eventTypes.ts` `SENSITIVITY_OPTIONS`.
- Form-control CSS (`.s-input/.s-select/.s-textarea/.s-toggle/.s-navitem`) → ensure shadcn
  `input/select/textarea/switch` match (focus ring = `0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft)`).

### Acceptance
- Token + primitive parity checklist completed; any gaps closed or filed as follow-ups.
- Shared status/sensitivity helpers in one place, used by events/types tasks.
- `pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build` green. No visual regression on existing pages.

title: Data-first redesign: align frontend to new Claude Design mockups
description:
## Data-first redesign — align frontend to the new Claude Design mockups

A new design handoff bundle (Claude Design, "Linear meets Stripe for tracking plans")
reworks the major Tripl surfaces. This epic tracks bringing the real `frontend/` in line
with those mockups, surface by surface, with attention to visual detail.

### Where the design lives
- Local, gitignored: `design/tripl/` (see `design/tripl/AGENTS.md` for the full file map).
- Read `design/tripl/chats/chat1.md` + `chat2.md` for intent, then `project/Tripl.html` + imports.
- Mockup data was reverse-engineered from the repo; **where mockup and real types disagree,
  the real API/types win** (e.g. `ScanConfig`, `eventTypes.ts`, the 7-state lifecycle).

### Design language (already mostly in `index.css` + `components/{primitives,ui}`)
- Type: Inter (UI) + JetBrains Mono (numbers/ids/event names). Tabular nums on metrics.
- Accent: teal `oklch(0.72 0.14 192)` default, 5 accents, dark default + light toggle.
- Density: compact 28 / cozy 36 / comfy 44px rows; header 44px.
- Tone scale: success/warning/danger/info with `-soft` variants; 4-tier fg hierarchy.
- Signals are inline (z-score chips, sparklines, pulse dots) — never tooltip-gated.

### Reworked surfaces (one task each)
1. Sidebar / app shell / navigation
2. Events list / table
3. Single event page + edit
4. Event types screen + type settings
5. Scans: list + single scan + edit/create
6. Plan branches
7. Reconciliation
8. Settings (full-takeover area)

Plus: a shared foundation task (tokens/primitives/lifecycle alignment) and a final visual
verification pass.

### Constraints
- Stack: React + TS + Vite + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui. Reuse existing primitives
  (`chip`, `dot`, `sparkline`, `mini-stat`, `sensitivity-chip`) and `ui/` components.
- `pnpm` only (never npm/yarn). Quality gates: `pnpm lint` (zero warnings), `pnpm test`,
  `pnpm build` (full type check).
- Keep authoring and review in separate passes. Do not regress existing tests.

title: Deduplicate variables before enum migration
description: Production enum migration failed while altering variables.variable_type because existing rows contain duplicate variables for the same project, branch, and name. Add a data cleanup step that merges duplicate Variable rows and their VariableValue contexts before the enum column rewrite rebuilds unique indexes.
close_reason: Added production data cleanup to merge duplicate variables and variable value contexts before enum table rewrites rebuild unique indexes.

title: Release-regression analyzer + ReleaseRegression model
description: New analyzer: for each event (and event_type) compare latest version vs previous version using T4's normalization and flag 'event missing in new release' and 'volume regressed in new release'. New ReleaseRegression model to store signals (missing-event is not a z-score anomaly, so it needs its own representation). Integrate into the metrics recalculation flow and populate result_summary counters.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic-series unit tests for missing/regressed/healthy cases; signals persisted & re-derived idempotently; result_summary reports counts; analyzer skipped entirely when column unset. ACCEPTANCE (cross-cutting): feature is fully inert when scan_config.app_version_column IS NULL — no extra warehouse queries, no version series, no regression signals, no alerts, no UI. Existing scans (incl. web with no app version) behave exactly as before.
close_reason: Added ReleaseRegression model + migration c2d3e4f5a6b7; pure analyzer worker/analyzers/release_regression.py implementing the decision-doc model (maturity gate on total-traffic share, activation-anchored overlap window, composition-share normalization, missing/volume_drop); recalc worker/tasks/metrics/regression.py wired into collect_metrics + result_summary[release_regressions_detected]; reuses sigma_threshold. Tests: 7 unit (analyzer) + 2 recalc (missing/idempotent, inert); full metrics suite 35 passed; ruff/mypy/alembic-graph clean. Inert when app_version_column unset.

title: DECISION: cross-version normalization model for regression comparison
description: Define how to compare a new release against the previous one given adoption skew (a fresh release has few users, so raw counts are not comparable). Decide the normalization (e.g. per-version share of that version's total events, or rate vs the version's project-total, and the adoption/minimum-volume gate before a regression can fire). Output: a written spec the analyzer (T5) implements.
acceptance_criteria: Decision doc records the normalization formula, the adoption gate, and the 'missing event' vs 'volume drop' criteria; reviewed before T5 starts.
notes: Decision recorded in internal/decisions/app-version-regression-model.md (kept out of the public docs/ set; beads task IDs stripped from the doc per review).
close_reason: Decision doc written at internal/decisions/app-version-regression-model.md: share-of-total maturity/active gate (excludes dev/tester build week), activation-anchored overlap window, composition-share normalization (expected vs observed), missing vs volume_drop classification, reuse of sigma_threshold/min_expected_count. Kept internal; beads jargon removed.

title: Collect per-version metric series with latest-N-release retention
description: When app_version_column is set, collect per-version series into EventMetricBreakdown (breakdown_column = app_version column). Replace the generic top-N-by-volume value selection with semver-aware retention: keep the latest N releases (app_version_keep_releases), group older releases into the 'other' bucket. Reuse the existing breakdown collection path; do not collect when column unset.
acceptance_criteria: Per-version rows stored & keyed correctly; retention keeps latest N by semver, not by volume; older releases collapse to is_other. ACCEPTANCE (cross-cutting): feature is fully inert when scan_config.app_version_column IS NULL — no extra warehouse queries, no version series, no regression signals, no alerts, no UI. Existing scans (incl. web with no app version) behave exactly as before.
close_reason: Added _collect_app_version_breakdown_rows in metric_rows.py: separate breakdown query with values_limit=None, SemVer-aware latest-N retention (app_version_keep_releases, default 10) via semver.order_versions, older releases folded into is_other "Other". Wired into process_chunk (chunk_processing.py) by merging version rows into breakdown_event/type_rows so delete/upsert/stats handle them uniformly. Inert (no warehouse query) when app_version_column is NULL. Test test_collect_metrics_retains_latest_app_versions_by_semver; 33 passed; ruff/mypy clean.

title: Semver utility (parse / compare / order) + unit tests
description: Backend utility to parse version strings into comparable keys, compare and order them (2.10.0 > 2.9.0), identify latest / previous release, with graceful lexical fallback for non-semver strings. Standalone, reusable by collection, retention and the regression analyzer.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover semver ordering, pre-release/build suffixes, mixed/invalid strings (deterministic fallback), latest/previous selection.
close_reason: Added standalone SemVer utility with parse/compare/order/latest-previous helpers and focused unit coverage for numeric ordering, prerelease/build precedence, invalid lexical fallback, and latest/previous selection. Tests: pytest src/tripl/tests/test_semver.py; ruff check semver/test_semver; mypy src/tripl/semver.py.

title: ScanConfig: app_version_column + app_version_keep_releases fields & migration
description: Add nullable app_version_column (String 255) and app_version_keep_releases (Integer, default e.g. 10) to ScanConfig model. Extend Create/Update/Response Pydantic schemas. Reserve app_version_column like time_column/event_type_column (extend check_scalar_columns_unreserved so it cannot also be a metric_breakdown/distribution_drift field). Alembic migration following backend/alembic/versions/1b2c3d4e5f60_add_event_metric_breakdown_columns.py as template; chain after current head; add to test_alembic_revisions. Update frontend ScanConfig TS type + scans api client shape.
acceptance_criteria: Fields nullable, default NULL/inert. Migration up/down + revision-graph test pass. Validation rejects using app_version_column as breakdown/drift. ACCEPTANCE (cross-cutting): feature is fully inert when scan_config.app_version_column IS NULL — no extra warehouse queries, no version series, no regression signals, no alerts, no UI. Existing scans (incl. web with no app version) behave exactly as before.
close_reason: Added nullable app_version_column (String 255) + app_version_keep_releases (Integer) to ScanConfig; Create/Update/Response schemas; check_scalar_columns_unreserved now reserves app_version_column (rejects using it as breakdown/drift) incl. PATCH path; migration b1c2d3e4f5a6 (single head, up/down); frontend ScanConfig type + scans api client. Tests: 26 passed; ruff/mypy/eslint/tsc clean. Inert when column NULL.

title: App-version observation in scans
description: Optional app-version column on a scan config enables per-version metric observation: collect per-version series (semver-ordered, retain latest N releases), detect release regressions (event disappeared / volume dropped in the newest version vs the previous one), surface them in alerts and a dedicated monitoring view. Level C scope (full): semver parsing + latest-N retention, version adoption, latest-version filters, dedicated alert-rule type. Version column is OPTIONAL: ACCEPTANCE (cross-cutting): feature is fully inert when scan_config.app_version_column IS NULL — no extra warehouse queries, no version series, no regression signals, no alerts, no UI. Existing scans (incl. web with no app version) behave exactly as before.

title: Audit role permissions
description: Review RBAC and role enforcement for destructive and sensitive project changes, identify gaps, then implement focused fixes.
acceptance_criteria: Role-sensitive API operations are audited; missing enforcement is fixed; targeted tests cover corrected behavior.
close_reason: Implemented RBAC audit fixes: owner-only project deletion, owner-only data source management, API-key limits for owner-only routes, write-key role guard, UI controls aligned, and targeted tests added.

title: Preserve variable links on manual event edits; allow full event editing from event detail page
description: Manual event PATCH wiped all VariableValue rows (scan-observed variable contexts) whenever field_values were sent, because update_event deleted them alongside EventFieldValue. VariableValue is keyed by field_definition_id and upserted by scans, so manual edits must not touch it. Also: event detail page (MonitoringDetailPage) was read-only; added Edit button opening the full EventForm sheet so all parameters are editable there, plus single-event query invalidation after save.
close_reason: Backend: update_event no longer deletes VariableValue rows on field_values updates; regression test test_update_event_preserves_variable_value_contexts. Frontend: Edit button + EventForm sheet on MonitoringDetailPage (event scope), single-event query invalidation after save. 408 backend tests, 78 frontend tests, ruff/eslint/tsc green. Pushed in 9082e7d.

title: Standardize branch-aware query keys: eventTypes/metaFields/event caches diverge on working branches
description: Branch-blind keys: MonitoringDetailPage.tsx:86,93,100; settings/ScansTab.tsx:595,219; command-palette.tsx:132. Branch-aware: events/useEventsPageData.ts:25,30,51; settings/EventTypesTab.tsx:49; settings/MetaFieldsTab.tsx:49. Two key shapes coexist ([entity, slug] vs [entity, slug, branchId]); branch-blind consumers fetch main-branch data, so on a working branch parts of the UI show main data while the events list shows branch data, and tab mutations invalidate only branch-aware keys so edits do not propagate until hard reload. Fix: standardize every eventTypes/metaFields/event query and invalidation on [entity, slug, branchId]; thread useActiveBranchId() through MonitoringDetailPage, ScansTab and command-palette and pass branchId into the API calls. Includes the event detail key (MonitoringDetailPage.tsx:86) omitting branchId.
close_reason: Standardized all eventTypes/metaFields/event query keys and invalidations on [entity, slug, branchId]. Threaded useActiveBranchId() through MonitoringDetailPage, ScansTab (incl. CreateMissingFieldsButton + ScanDetail), command-palette and EventDetailPage, passing branchId into the API calls so fetched data matches the key and tab mutations propagate without a hard reload.

title: Delete dead EventDetailPage.tsx (unreachable, stale duplicate)
description: src/pages/EventDetailPage.tsx:37. App.tsx is the only router; routes /p/:slug/events/detail/:eventId (App.tsx:118) and /p/:slug/monitoring/:scope/:id (App.tsx:119) both render MonitoringDetailPage. EventDetailPage is never imported (grep confirms only its own export). It is a stale near-duplicate lacking annotations/heatmap/top-movers and eagerly imports recharts. Fix: delete the file; also removes a second eager recharts importer.
close_reason: Deleted src/pages/EventDetailPage.tsx — confirmed unreferenced (App.tsx routes both event-detail and monitoring paths to MonitoringDetailPage). Removes a stale near-duplicate and a second eager recharts importer.

title: Rate limiter trusts X-Forwarded-For unconditionally, allowing limit bypass
description: middleware/rate_limit.py:85-94. _client_key takes the leftmost X-Forwarded-For value with no trusted-proxy check. An attacker rotating XFF per request fully bypasses the login/register rate limit, defeating credential-stuffing protection. Fix: add a rate_limit_trust_forwarded_for setting; only honor XFF when enabled, otherwise use request.client.host. Add a spoofed-XFF test.
close_reason: Added rate_limit_trust_forwarded_for setting (default False). _client_key now only honors X-Forwarded-For when the setting is enabled (trusted-proxy deployments); otherwise uses request.client.host, so rotating XFF can no longer spray fresh buckets. Spoofed-XFF test in test_security_middleware.py.

title: Pending alert deliveries stranded if worker dies between commit and dispatch; add reaper beat task
description: worker/tasks/metrics/__init__.py:1588-1596, dispatch.py:160. Deliveries are committed as pending and send_alert_delivery.delay() is enqueued after the outer commit. If the worker crashes between commit and the dispatch loop, or .delay() raises against a down broker, pending deliveries are never dispatched and never retried (cleanup_schema_drifts is the only maintenance task). Fix: add a periodic beat task that re-enqueues AlertDelivery rows stuck in pending older than N minutes, bounded by a max-attempt counter.
close_reason: Added requeue_stranded_alert_deliveries reaper beat task (maintenance.py) that re-enqueues AlertDelivery rows stuck in pending past STRANDED_DELIVERY_MINUTES=15, bounded by dispatch_attempts < MAX_DISPATCH_ATTEMPTS=5 (new column + migration 4f5e6d7c8b9a); exhausted rows are marked failed. Registered on a 5-minute beat schedule. Covered by test_requeue_stranded_alert_deliveries_redispatches_and_bounds_attempts.

title: Duplicate alert notifications: acks_late without idempotency guard in send_alert_delivery
description: worker/celery_app.py:25-26, worker/tasks/alerts.py:507-775. With task_acks_late=True and task_reject_on_worker_lost=True, a worker SIGKILLed (OOM/deploy) after _send_telegram_message/_send_jira_issue succeeded but before session.commit() (alerts.py:751) gets the task re-queued and re-executed, re-sending the message or creating a duplicate Jira/Linear ticket. Fix: at the top of send_alert_delivery re-load the delivery and return early if status==sent; for ticket channels store the external id in payload_snapshot and skip creation if present. Add a test calling send_alert_delivery twice on a sent delivery asserting a single external send. Same pattern applies to collect_metrics re-runs.
close_reason: send_alert_delivery now returns early (already_sent) if status==sent. Ticket channels (Jira/Linear) persist external issue id/key into payload_snapshot and skip creation if already present; the id is committed immediately after creation (before the final status=sent commit) so a SIGKILL in that window can't create a duplicate ticket on re-run. _post_json returns the parsed response; _send_jira_issue/_send_linear_issue return (id, key). Tests: idempotent resend (status guard) and skip-creation-when-id-present (crash-window guard).

title: SSRF: webhook/Jira destination URLs accept internal hosts
description: alerting_validation.py:53-69,164-165,235-236. _validate_https_url only checks scheme==https and non-empty netloc. Slack is host-allowlisted but webhook target URLs and Jira base URLs are not: an editor can point a destination at https://169.254.169.254/ (cloud metadata) or internal RFC1918 hosts; the worker (_post_json, alerts.py:225) issues the request from inside the trusted network and surfaces the response body in error_message (blind exfiltration). Fix: add _reject_private_host(parsed.hostname) using ipaddress is_private/is_loopback/is_link_local plus socket.getaddrinfo; reject at validation time AND re-check at send time (DNS rebinding). Add negative tests for private-IP rejection.
close_reason: Added reject_private_host() in alerting_validation.py (ipaddress is_private/loopback/link-local/reserved/multicast/unspecified + socket.getaddrinfo, fails closed on DNS error). Webhook target URLs and Jira base URLs now reject internal/metadata hosts at validation time via block_private_hosts; re-checked at send time in alerts.py (_reject_private_target) to defend against DNS rebinding. Negative tests for literal private IPs, metadata IP, IPv6 loopback, DNS-resolves-to-private, and fail-closed-on-DNS-error.

title: Investigate scheduled variable value reset
description: Check why scheduled metrics collection appears to clear variable observed values after replay populated them, validate against production if credentials are available locally, and fix the update path.
notes: Blocked on production access: agentmemory has no prod Tripl URL/key, current environment has no matching TRIPL/PROD/API/TOKEN/KEY/URL variables, and local repo search only found .env.example placeholders. Need prod API base URL and API key/token from user before inspecting production state.
close_reason: Confirmed in production that scheduled metrics_collection reset variable context samples to observed_count=0/values=[] after replay enrichment. Fixed event generation to preserve existing variable context values when rescan payloads are empty, and added regression coverage.

title: Review changes since e30419e
description: Validate changes from commit e30419e534948d0933173997028555e52ac7f12b to HEAD, fix regressions, and run relevant quality gates.
close_reason: Validated changes since e30419e, fixed row-limit boundary handling, grouped scan regression, scan_row_limit propagation, search token regex escaping, and compact variable value rendering; full backend/frontend quality gates passed.

title: Add observed value contexts for tracking-plan variables
description: Variables currently store only name/type/description, so users and agents cannot see where a variable appears or which concrete values it can take. Add a variable_values model that records observed values per variable-event-field context. Low-cardinality contexts must keep all observed values; high-cardinality contexts must keep a bounded sample. Expose summaries in the Variables settings table, inline low-cardinality values on event list/detail field values, and include the context in API/search indexing for agent retrieval.
design: Add a branch-scoped variable_values table linked to variables, events, and field_definitions. Populate it from scan/metrics catalog refresh when generated field values contain real ${var} placeholders. Do not create variables for ordinary low-cardinality fields. Reindex project branch after value-context refreshes so event and variable search documents include values.
acceptance_criteria: Variables API returns event/value usage summaries. Event list/detail API returns variable value contexts per field value. Scan-generated high-cardinality variable contexts store only bounded examples. Scan-generated low-cardinality variable contexts store all observed values. VariablesTab shows usage/value summaries. Events table and event detail show low-cardinality value tooltip/popover. Search documents include variable value context. Backend and frontend tests cover API, scan generation, UI rendering, and search text.
close_reason: Implemented variable value contexts across storage, scan generation, API, search indexing, and frontend summaries/popovers. Targeted backend tests, backend lint/type checks, frontend lint/type checks, and new frontend tests pass; full frontend suite still has unrelated ProjectSettings scan-preview failures that reproduce when that file runs alone.

title: Run scan event group apply asynchronously
description: The Apply Groups scan action can time out at the gateway when merging many existing catalog events and metrics synchronously. Move post-factum event group application behind a worker-dispatched scan job so the API returns quickly and progress/result is visible in scan jobs.
close_reason: Fixed: Apply Groups now creates a scan job and dispatches Celery task tripl.worker.tasks.scan.apply_event_groups instead of merging synchronously in the API request.

title: Add search reindex action in project settings
description: Expose the existing project search reindex endpoint in the UI so users can rebuild search_documents and schedule embeddings after deployment or stale search results.
close_reason: Added a project settings action to rebuild the search index and covered it with a frontend test.

title: Implement multilingual hybrid knowledge search
description: Add PostgreSQL-backed hybrid search over tracking-plan knowledge with multilingual lexical/fuzzy matching, optional embeddings, API endpoints, frontend command palette integration, and tests.
close_reason: Implemented multilingual hybrid knowledge search with Postgres search_documents, API, indexing hooks, optional embeddings, command palette integration, and coverage.

title: Skip full catalog sync during metrics replay
description: Metrics replay currently runs full cardinality/event sync over the entire scan base_query before chunked metric collection, so replay_chunk_interval does not protect the heaviest warehouse query. Change replay to reuse existing catalog mappings and only chunk metric collection.
close_reason: Metrics replay now skips full catalog cardinality sync and reuses existing event mappings while keeping chunked metric collection.

title: Investigate production old event type metrics gap
description: Investigate why production metrics for the old event type show zero buckets while total volume does not drop.
close_reason: False alarm: production gap was caused by replaying the scan for the wrong date window.

title: Expose event-level metric breakdown selection
description: Users need to choose breakdown columns on individual catalog events so only selected events get country/device/etc breakdowns during metrics collection and alert analysis. The backend has event-level metric_breakdown_columns support, but the event settings UI should make this discoverable and ergonomic.
close_reason: Replaced raw event breakdown column input with selectable event-level metric breakdown controls and surfaced configured breakdowns on event details.

title: Add bulk event state actions
description: Catalog table selection currently only supports bulk delete. Users need to apply reviewed and archived state transitions to selected events so batches can be moved between active, review, and archive views.
close_reason: Added bulk event state endpoint and catalog bulk actions for reviewed, review, archive, and restore transitions.

title: Fix scan JSON value path discovery
description: Saved JSON value paths remain active after preview recomputation but disappear from the scan configuration UI. JSON path discovery also depends on the current preview sample, so users cannot see the full set of candidate paths. Update scan preview/config behavior so saved paths stay visible and discovery can enumerate candidates separately from sampled preview rows.
close_reason: Implemented separate JSON path discovery for scan preview and kept saved json_value_paths visible in the edit UI.

title: Restore backend-wide ruff and format gates
description: Backend-wide ruff check currently reports B008 in chart_annotations.py, and backend-wide ruff format --check reports legacy formatting drift. Fix these so full backend ruff check and format gates pass without target lists.
close_reason: Fixed chart_annotations B008 and applied backend-wide ruff format; full backend ruff, mypy, and pytest now pass.

title: Split metrics replay/collection into time-interval chunks
description: Long replays ran a single warehouse query over the whole window in collect_metrics Phase 2 (time-bucketed counts + breakdowns + distribution drift), which timed out on large ranges. Add a per-scan ScanConfig.replay_chunk_interval (interval code, must be >= the collection interval) and split the collection window into interval-aligned sub-windows: per-chunk query + delete + UPSERT with incremental commits. Anomaly recalculation and alert delivery run once over the full window. NULL preserves legacy single-query behavior.
acceptance_criteria: replay_chunk_interval persisted on ScanConfig and validated (requires interval, not finer than interval); collect_metrics issues one bounded warehouse query per chunk; distribution drift results match unchunked output; backend + frontend quality gates green.
close_reason: Implemented on branch feat/replay-chunked-scans (commit e98cc15): per-scan replay_chunk_interval + chunked collect_metrics Phase 2, migration 2c3d4e5f6071, schema/service validation, frontend form field. Backend 225 tests + frontend 35 tests green.

title: Fix Alembic field sensitivity revision cycle
description: Alembic fails with a revision cycle because the field sensitivity migration reuses an existing revision id. Rename the new migration revision and verify the migration graph.
close_reason: Fixed by assigning a unique Alembic revision id to the field sensitivity migration and verified the migration graph.

title: Fix Alembic duplicate revision cycle
description: Alembic upgrade fails because migration revisions a1b2c3d4e5f6 and b2c3d4e5f6a7 are duplicated, producing a cyclic revision graph. Make the migration graph linear/acyclic and verify Alembic can resolve heads.
close_reason: Fixed by giving the two new migrations unique revision IDs and chaining them after the previous head.

title: Make Layout and sidebar mobile-responsive
description: Below md breakpoint: sidebar slides off-canvas with toggle in TopBar; padding tightens; ActivityPanel becomes overlay. Above md: keep current behaviour.

title: Tracking plan versioning + diff
description:
Snapshot the entire tracking plan (event types, field definitions, relations, meta fields, variables, events) into immutable plan_revision rows so users can see when the schema changed and what changed.

MVP scope:
1. plan_revisions table + Alembic migration: id, project_id (FK), created_at, created_by (FK to users, nullable), summary (text), payload (JSON snapshot of the project schema).
2. Service: build_plan_snapshot(project_id) constructs the payload from current rows; create_revision persists it.
3. API:
   - POST /projects/{slug}/revisions — manual snapshot, optional summary
   - GET /projects/{slug}/revisions — list (paginated)
   - GET /projects/{slug}/revisions/{id} — full detail
   - GET /projects/{slug}/revisions/{id}/diff?compare_to={other_id} — entity-level diff (added/removed/changed)
4. Frontend: /p/:slug/settings/history tab — table of revisions with timestamps and authors, click to expand a diff against the previous revision, 'Snapshot now' button with optional note.

Out of scope for MVP: auto-snapshot on every mutation, breaking-change alert scope, approval workflow, rollback action.
design: Payload shape: { event_types: [...], events: [...], variables: [...], meta_fields: [...], relations: [...] }. Each entity carries only the fields that affect downstream consumers (name, display_name, field_type, is_required, enum_options, etc.) — created_at / updated_at / order / UUIDs go through so we can stable-sort but aren't compared for diff purposes. Diff is computed in Python over the two payloads using a small set-difference helper per entity type. No re-query at diff time — payload-vs-payload makes the diff deterministic even after later deletes.
close_reason: New plan_revisions table (Alembic 9e0f1a2b3c4d). build_plan_snapshot constructs deterministic JSON over event types + field definitions + events + variables + meta fields + relations (sorted by natural key, UUIDs / order / timestamps excluded from comparison fields). compute_plan_diff_entries does natural-key set difference per entity type, surfaces field-level changes for the fields that matter (field_type, is_required, enum_options, implemented/reviewed/archived, etc.). API: POST/GET /projects/{slug}/revisions, GET /revisions/{id}, GET /revisions/{id}/diff?compare_to={other}. Frontend: HistoryTab in ProjectSettingsPage with revision list + 'Snapshot now' button + side-by-side diff against previous revision. Tests: 176 backend (+3 — snapshot composition, diff classification, full POST→GET→diff round-trip), 33 frontend. ruff+mypy+tsc+eslint clean.

The metrics pipeline already knows event_id and bucket_ts. A single UPDATE in the same transaction as event_metrics insert is enough.

title: Schema drift detector + last-seen in catalog
description:
Event implementation status is currently set manually, and differences between the declared schema and real ClickHouse data are only visible through manual scan-result inspection.

Goal: automatically maintain last-seen for each Event and raise SchemaDrift when known-event data gains new fields or changes dominant type. This becomes the primary signal that the catalog diverged from production.

Scope:
1. Event.last_seen_at (nullable timestamptz) + migration.
2. Metrics pipeline updates last_seen_at for non-zero counts in the window.
3. last seen column in EventsPage + silent > 7d filter.
4. SchemaDrift model (event_id, field_name, drift_type, detected_at, sample_value).
5. Cardinality analyzer compares current fields with FieldDefinition and writes drift records.
6. Anomaly scope=schema flows into the alert pipeline.
7. UI: drift badge on EventRow + drill-down with examples.
design:
Do not duplicate metric tables. last_seen_at is just a projection, updated in the same transaction as event_metrics insert. SchemaDrift is a separate table because it has its own retention; 30 days is enough.

Alert pipeline already knows scope=project/event_type/event; add schema as a fourth scope. alert_templates.py receives variables drift_field, drift_type, and sample_value.
